result.finding: Assessed 15 CWE rules in Memory Safety: 0 FOUND, 15 NOT_FOUND
evidence: Scanned application source files for memory safety patterns

values.name: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer
values.description: The product performs operations on a memory buffer, but it reads from or writes to a memory location outside the buffer's intended boundary. This may result in read or write operations on unexpected memory locations that could be linked to other variables, data structures, or internal program data.

values.name: Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input
values.description: Copies input buffer to output without verifying input size < output size

values.name: Write-what-where Condition
values.description: Attacker can write arbitrary value to arbitrary location (e.g., result of buffer overflow)

values.name: Out-of-bounds Read
values.description: Reads data past end or before beginning of intended buffer

values.name: Double Free
values.description: Calls free() twice on the same memory address

values.name: Use After Free
values.description: Reuses or references memory after it has been freed

values.name: Operation on a Resource after Expiration or Release
values.description: Uses/accesses resource after it has been expired, released, or revoked

values.name: Access of Memory Location Before Start of Buffer
values.description: Reads/writes buffer using index/pointer before beginning of buffer

values.name: Out-of-bounds Write
values.description: Writes data past end or before beginning of intended buffer

values.name: Access of Memory Location After End of Buffer
values.description: Reads/writes buffer using index/pointer after end of buffer

values.name: Buffer Access with Incorrect Length Value
values.description: Uses incorrect length value causing access outside buffer bounds

values.name: Untrusted Pointer Dereference
values.description: Obtains value from untrusted source, converts to pointer, dereferences it

values.name: Use of Out-of-range Pointer Offset
values.description: Performs pointer arithmetic with offset that can point outside valid memory

values.name: Access of Uninitialized Pointer
values.description: Accesses or uses a pointer that has not been initialized

values.name: Expired Pointer Dereference
values.description: Dereferences a pointer for memory that was previously valid but is no longer valid
